i1.title: Spirit of Osun
i1.description: Oil on canvas reinterpreting the figure of the goddess Osun through a warm palette of golds and deep greens.

i2.title: Mask of Silence
i2.description: Iroko wood carving inspired by Igbo ceremonial masks, finished with a bronze patina.

i3.title: Lagos Market at Dawn
i3.description: Documentary series on daily life in the markets of Lagos, captured in the early hours of the day.

i4.title: Woven Roots
i4.description: Tapestry made with traditional Yoruba weaving techniques combined with gold metallic thread.

i5.title: Digital Crown
i5.description: Generative composition merging traditional geometric patterns with an Afrofuturist aesthetic.

i6.title: Harmattan Dance
i6.description: Acrylic capturing the movement of traditional dancers during the harmattan season.

i7.title: Bronze Guardian
i7.description: Bronze cast paying tribute to the historic Benin Bronzes.

i8.title: Portraits of Abuja
i8.description: Black-and-white portraits of artisans and traders in the Nigerian capital.

i9.title: Adire Cloth
i9.description: Fabric dyed using the traditional adire technique, reinterpreted with contemporary motifs.

i10.title: Fragments of Identity
i10.description: Digital collage exploring the identity of the Nigerian diaspora in Europe.

i11.title: River Niger at Sunset
i11.description: Large-format oil depicting the River Niger bathed in golden tones at sunset.

i12.title: Voices of Ibadan
i12.description: Collective portrait of the artistic community of Ibadan.

team.title: About us
team.subtitle: The people behind Naijart, working to bring Nigerian art to Europe.

m1.bio: Painter and cultural manager born in Lagos. Founded Naijart in 2023 to build bridges between contemporary Nigerian art and European audiences.

m2.bio: Responsible for keeping the link between member artists and the Nigerian community in Europe. Organises the monthly meet-ups.

m3.bio: Designs and coordinates exhibitions, fairs and presentations across European cities. Ten years of experience in cultural management.

hero.title: Join Naijart
hero.subtitle: We are looking for artists who want to show their work in Europe and for people willing to collaborate with the association. If that sounds like you, this is your place.

b1.title: International exposure
b1.description: Your work reaches a European audience through our exhibitions, events and digital channels.

b2.title: Community
b2.description: You become part of a network of Nigerian artists and collaborators united by a shared purpose.

b3.title: Resources and training
b3.description: Access to workshops, mentoring and resources designed to boost your artistic career or your work as a collaborator.

b4.title: Network of contacts
b4.description: Direct connections with galleries, event organisers and other cultural associations in Europe.

s1.title: Send your application
s1.description: Fill in the form with your details and tell us a little about yourself.

s2.title: We review your profile
s2.description: Our team reviews every application carefully, with no rush and no automatic filters.

s3.title: We get in touch
s3.description: We email you to explain the next steps.

s4.title: You become part of Naijart
s4.description: We welcome you into the community and we start building together.

t1.quote: Joining Naijart opened doors I did not know existed in Europe. Today I am showing my work outside Nigeria for the first time.

t2.quote: As a volunteer, I found a space where my work really matters and where every contribution is valued.

t3.quote: The community is what I value most. I have never felt alone on this path.
